title: David acts mad before King Achish in Gath
description: David flees from Saul and comes to King Achish in Gath. When Achish's servants recognize him as the one they sang about – "Saul has struck his thousands, and David his ten thousands" – David becomes very afraid. He pretends to be mad and behaves like a crazy man, scratching on the gate doors and letting saliva run down into his beard. Achish dismisses him as a madman and asks the servants why they have brought him there.
